title: 4521-ESP-AGE-74-70-0003 R1 Ultrasonic Flowmeter Specification
summary:
- Document is for the Ultrasonic Flowmeter project.
- Initials required on cover sheet only, other title block info on all pages.
- Revisions are detailed in the body of the specification.
- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle allows non-standard billing cycles.
- Confidentiality clause restricts use and reproduction of information.
- The ultrasonic flowmeter is for the Outlet Scrubber Spray Cooler - HTF side.
- It has a process connection of inline-butt weld and dual channel transducers.
- The transmitter has an output signal of 4...20 mA + HART and operates at 120 VAC.
- The instrument tag material is 316 SS with a size of 2" * 4".
